blocks.text: PROSPERIDAD, Agusan del Sur –A visiting Australian scientist has called for a sweeping overhaul of how Philippine agricultural laboratories handle soil diagnostics, warning that without unified standards, high-tech test results will remain functionally useless to smallholder farmers struggling against severe climate shocks. Australian research fellow Xiangyu Lin said the biggest barrier hobbling farm productivity is not a lack of analytical skill, but a systemic failure to standardize testing protocols across regional borders. Lin, a specialist in artificial intelligence (AI) and soil biogeochemistry at Griffith University’s School of Environment and Science, served as a primary resource speaker under an initiative supported by […]...
